about.description1: At Deep Blue Cargo, we don't just move freight; we navigate the complexities of global trade so you don't have to. Founded on the principles of maritime excellence, we have grown into a premier end-to-end specialist, bridging continents through a seamless network of ocean routes and strategic port partnerships.

services.title: OUR SERVICES
services.heading: We Are Trusted For Our Services
services.description: Deploying a sophisticated network of global logistics routes, Deep Blue Cargo provides uncompromising security for your most valuable assets. We combine real-time tracking with exclusive handling protocols to ensure every shipment arrives with surgical precision.

fcl.title: FCL Shipping
fcl.description: Maximize your efficiency with Full Container Loads. We provide dedicated 20ft and 40ft container solutions with priority vessel space, ensuring your bulk cargo moves with absolute security and cost-effectiveness across every major global trade lane.

lcl.title: LCL Consolidation
lcl.description: Big global reach for smaller shipments. Our Less than Container Load service allows you to pay only for the space you use. We expertly consolidate your cargo with others to provide the most economical sea freight rates without compromising on transit speed.

port_to_door.title: Port-to-Door
port_to_door.description: Seamless integration from ocean to inland. Deep Blue Cargo handles the entire journey. We manage the complex hand-off from vessel to truck, including customs clearance and final-mile delivery, providing you with a single point of accountability.

why_choose_us.title: WHY CHOOSE US
why_choose_us.heading: The ocean is vast, but your supply chain shouldn't be a mystery. We provide the stability your business needs to grow globally.
why_choose_us.description: Global Reach, Local Expertise \nNavigating international waters requires more than just ships; it requires knowledge. We maintain a robust network of strategic port partnerships and local customs experts worldwide, ensuring your cargo moves seamlessly across borders without the typical 'red tape' delays.

security.description: Maximum protection for your highest assets. We don't just deliver; we safeguard the irreplaceable through a multi-layered defense system.

packaging.title: Tamper-Evident Packaging
packaging.description: Every high-value shipment is sealed in medical-grade TEB bags with hot-melt adhesive technology that reveals any interference instantly.

discreet.title: Discreet 'Invisible' Logistics
discreet.description: We utilize blind labeling with no mention of contents or value on the exterior, ensuring your assets remain a non-target during transit.

custody.title: Verified Chain of Custody
custody.description: A strict digital audit trail tracks every hand-off. Employees must verify their unique ID at every scan point from pickup to delivery.

signature.title: Zero-Waiver Signature
signature.description: No front-door drops. We require mandatory government ID verification and a physical signature for every secure-chain delivery.

trust_footer.title: 100% Insured Transit
trust_footer.description: Every high-value shipment is backed by our global security guarantee.

faq.description: Everything you need to know about shipping with Deep Blue Cargo.

items.question: How do you secure high-value items like jewelry or money chains?
items.answer: We use a 'Secure-Chain' protocol which includes 3-layer tamper-evident packaging, blind labeling (no contents mentioned on the box), and a mandatory GPS-tracked chain of custody. Your items are never left unattended.

items.question: What is the maximum weight for the Express Courier service?
items.answer: Our courier branch focuses on lightweight, high-priority shipments. We typically handle parcels up to 30kg (66lbs). For anything heavier, please contact our freight division for an LCL quote.

items.question: Will I have to pay customs duties and taxes separately?
items.answer: This depends on your chosen Incoterm. For DDP (Delivered Duty Paid), we include all taxes in your quote. For other terms, customs may contact the receiver for payment before final release.

items.question: What happens if a high-value shipment is delayed?
items.answer: While we maintain a 99% on-time record, international customs can occasionally hold items for inspection. We provide real-time updates and have dedicated brokers to expedite the clearance process.

items.question: Is my shipment insured during international transit?
items.answer: Yes. Every shipment includes a base insurance. For high-value assets like jewelry, we offer 'Full Value Protection' which covers the 100% declared value of the item against loss or damage.
